book.name: 2 TIMOTE
book.title: Mukaana wu a myele kundaa Timote

content: Mamboro
Me Poole, ntumu a Yiisu-Kriste mu waa li Nzaami, bwunu a bu oli misiini mi bumweẽ bu buli mu Yiisu-Kriste,
nsono mukaana wu kundaa Timote, mwana a me wu mukolo. Nyaã ti bwehe, nyiĩ ya edzuunu bi bifi kundaa Nzaami Taara ya kundaa Mfumu a bihi Yiisu-Kriste bikala ya we!
Poole bvurulu matuono kundaa Nzaami
Me aakamvurulu matuono malagha kundaa Nzaami, wu aakansalala me mu bitsimi bibi tse-tse ti anga bu ósalala bankagha ba me. Matala mwohono, me aakansamana mu we mpyibi ya mwiĩ.
Me aakandibili mweẽ mu mansaŋa ma we, ya me ndi a nzala a omono we kuu olagha mpaala me ndwulu mu esee.
Me aakandibili si mweẽ mu kana li we lili ngaŋma, bwunu a bu óli kana li nkagha a we Loyidze ya lili ngughu a we Enise. Me ngyighili osoolo ti kana lilo lili si mu we.
Omono mpara ya Poole mu nkooro a Nsia yi Mbwe
Mu obo, me ndibili we mweẽ mu ofirifulu mbaa a ekaba ki ógwi we Nzaami mu matala ma ánaŋa me we myaã ŋa yulu a mutswi.
Mu kuulu, Nzaami ka ágwi bihi-a-be mufulu wu a nzalamweẽ o, lo mufulu wu a mpini, wu a dzyi ya wu okakuru nyuru.
Ka kala a budzwa mu osuo bumpughulu bu Mfumu a bihi o, ka kala a budzwa mu me wu ndi mu boloko mu nkooro a nde o. Lo mono mpara ya me mu nkooro a Nsia yi Mbwe mu lileene li Nzaami.

content.text: ya wu aati bihi mbili mu okala a bumweẽ bubu ngili,
ka mu nkooro a bigyighili bi bihi bi bibwe o,
lo bwunu a bu oli bitsimi bi ákuru nde, bwunu a bu oli bwehe
Mu matala ma, bwehe bubo buumoŋono ŋa omoŋono Mfumu a bihi Yiisu-Kriste,
ya wu aasuo ŋa tse-tse laama lili mibvu ya mibvu mu nzili a Nsia yi Mbwe.

content: Me mu nkooro a Nsia yi Mbwe oyo Nzaami aasuolo me mu okala wu aakata mukwughu, ntumu ya muluo.

Me mu nkooro a ndagha oyo me ndi mu okamono mpara yi. Lo me ka ndi a budzwa mu ndagha oyo o, mu kuulu me ngyahaba mu nande me aansi kana. Ya me ndi a emiini ti nde li a lileene mu okebe ma ágwi nde me tee mu etsughu ekye.
Kwara, mu kana ya mu dzyi li lili mu Yiisu-Kriste, efaana ki mandagha mama nsumu ma ágyughu we kundaa me.
Kebe, mu nzili a Mufulu a Ngili wu li mu bihi, mandagha mwohono ma mabwe ma bágwi we.
Bunsumu bu Onesifore
We soolo ti baara bwohono ba bali ku Adzi baanyaghala me. Fingele ya Eremongene bali mu mutala a bo.
Nyaã Mfumu amono nzo a Onesifore nyiĩ mu kuulu matala malagha, nde aakagwa me mpini, ya ka aakamono budzwa mu me wu ndi mu boloko o.
Me mu obo, nde bu aagyi ku bvulu lili Rome, nde aasi maswa mu osagha me ya nde aamono me.
Nyaã Mfumu Yiisu agwa nde bwehe mu etsughu kii mumfwunu, mpaala Nzaami amono nde nyiĩ. We weme gyighili osoolo obvulu baara bwohono ti ku bvulu lili Efedze, nde áabaha bihi.
